name: Revolution
author: superhac
description: A desktop and cab theme with a wheel carousel, the table's playfield and the features it ships with.
change_log:
Rebuilt for VPinFE 3.0.

Core now handles input, audio, preloading, layout, the loading indicator, attract mode and the backglass and score view pages, so the theme is one playfield page. The wheel slides one step at a time and cuts when a page jumps.

The playfield art is the video or picture that Playfield Media Priority in VPinFE's settings asks for.

Start on Collection Selection carries over from VPinFE 2.x. When it is off, Revolution starts on the collection set by Open On in VPinFE's settings.
